name: checkbox
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Checkbox for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned keyboard/ARIA checkbox primitive (checked/indeterminate/unchecked), with a Lucide Check indicator. Requires the web feature since the primitive's hidden bubble input needs the browser DOM to sync indeterminate state.
documentation.usage: Checkbox { checked: checked(), on_checked_change: move |v| checked.set(v) }
documentation.accessibility: `role="checkbox"` with `aria-checked` of `true`/`false`/`mixed` (tri-state support), per the WAI-ARIA APG Checkbox pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/checkbox.rs`). A hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` mirrors state for plain HTML form submission.
documentation.keyboard: Toggles only on Space, not Enter -- the APG reserves Enter for a form's default-submit button, not checkbox activation.
